title: mutex for particularly likely to race relationship methods
body:
if we look at where class_mapper() with configure=False occurs:

```
$ grep -H configure=False lib/sqlalchemy/orm/*.py
lib/sqlalchemy/orm/base.py:def _inspect_mapped_class(class_, configure=False):
lib/sqlalchemy/orm/mapper.py:                self.inherits = class_mapper(self.inherits, configure=False)
lib/sqlalchemy/orm/relationships.py:            return mapperlib.class_mapper(argument, configure=False)
lib/sqlalchemy/orm/relationships.py:            self.parent.class_, configure=False

```


it's pretty easy to get a race for relationship.mapper() (or relationship.entity() in master), script below.     Other race conditions, like someone calling query(Class) while Class is still being configured, are not possible because we are calling configure() on those.

I'm not sure if this can be solved without extensive addition of locks, I thought adding it into relationship.mapper might be enough but at the moment it isn't working, test script:

```
import random
import threading
import time

from sqlalchemy import Column
from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy import Integer
from sqlalchemy import String
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declared_attr
from sqlalchemy.orm import clear_mappers
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

def make_a(Base):
    global A
    class A(Base):
        __tablename__ = "a"

        id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
        data = Column(String)
        bs = relationship("B")

def query_a(Base):
    s = Session()
    time.sleep(random.random() / 100)
    try:
        s.query(A).join(A.bs)
    except Exception as err:
        raise
        print(err)
    else:
        print("worked")

def make_b(Base):
    global B


    class B(Base):
        __tablename__ = "b"
        id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)

        @declared_attr
        def data(cls):
            time.sleep(.001)
            return Column(String)

        a_id = Column(ForeignKey("a.id"))


while True:
    Base = declarative_base()
    clear_mappers()

    make_a(Base)
    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=make_b, args=(Base,)),
        threading.Thread(target=query_a, args=(Base,)),
    ]

    for t in threads:
        t.start()

    for t in threads:
        t.join()

```
